dataList.name: Learning by Example
dataList.desc:
Max Stack: 30
Gain Stacks based on the following conditions:
- On Clash Win, gain 2 Stacks; On Hit using Base Attack Skills, gain 1 Stack; At Attack End, if the enemy was defeated, gain 3 Stacks
- On Clash Win using Base Attack Skills by other allies, gain 2 Stacks
 · On Clash Win using Base Attack Skills by other allies in the same faction as this unit, gain 4 Stacks instead

Gain the following effects cumulatively based on Stacks:
- Base Attack Skills deal +1% damage for every Stack (max 30%)
- 10+: Base Attack Skills Clash Power +1
- 20+: Base Attack Skills Coin Power +1
dataList.summary:
Gain Stacks based on certain conditions
Deal more damage, gain Clash Power, gain Coin Power based on Stacks

dataList.name: The One Beyond Despair
dataList.desc:
- Turn Start: Gain 2 Protection and 1 Attack Power Up
- On Defense Skill Use, gain 3 Defense Power Up (once per turn)
- On Clash Win, heal 5 SP (2 times per turn)
 · At max SP, remove 1 removable negative effect applied to self
- At Base Skill End, deal Pride damage equal to 10% of damage the said Skill dealt to each enemy

- When this unit takes damage that brings its HP down to 0, it does not take damage for the turn (once per Encounter)
 · After the above effect activates, heal all HP next turn; then, deal +10% damage for every Protection on self until Combat End (max 80%)

dataList.name: Field Analysis
dataList.desc:
- Max Stack: 4
- Gain +2 Poise Count when gaining this effect
- Turn End: Gain +(Stack x 2) Poise Count
- Skills gain the following effects based on Stack:

 · 3+: Coin Power +1, the final Coin becomes Unbreakable Coin
 · 4+: Target's Pierce Resist. +0.1 until Attack End

dataList.name: Fire Butterfly Coffin
dataList.desc:
- Max Stack: 30
- On Hit using Base Skills, gain 3 Stacks
 · If the said Skill is Skill 1 used via the "Dawn Office - Seonbae" Passive, gain 1 more Stack
 · If target has Burn, gain 1 more Stack
- Turn End: At more than 20 Stacks, gain (excess Stack / 2) Burn next turn (rounded down)
 · At 30 Stacks, gain 5 Burn and +2 Burn Count instead
dataList.flavor:
Heated to a smoldering temperature within the coffin are butterflies, the kaleidoscope spilling forth to melt and tear the target apart.

"This type of weapon is still too premature for you to wield, Philip, but it shouldn't hurt to at least learn how it works."

"All those blades inside the coffin make it much easier to deal with multiple opponents at once. That way, you can even take on jobs that would normally be too much for a single Fixer to handle."
